title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state that the total charge passing through R4 is CE.

title: Initial capacitor charge
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the initial charge on the capacitor when the switch is open, Q1 = C * (R2/(R1+R2)) * E.

title: Final capacitor charge
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the final steady-state charge on the capacitor after the switch is closed, Q2 = C * (R1/(R1+R2)) * E.

title: Charge conservation reasoning
description: Important Criteria: The response must apply charge conservation, stating that the charge passing through R4 equals the sum of the magnitudes of the initial and final capacitor charges.

title: Steady-state analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The response may explain that in steady state, the capacitor acts as an open circuit, allowing correct voltage division to be found.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the response incorrectly subtracts the charges instead of adding their magnitudes, or confuses the direction of current/charge flow.

title: Voltage division mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the response incorrectly calculates the voltage across the capacitor in either the initial or final state, such as by misidentifying series/parallel combinations.
